short_answer: Mahendra Singh Dhoni was born on 7 July 1981 in Ranchi, Bihar (now Jharkhand), India. Dhoni captained the Indian national team to victory in the 2011 Cricket World Cup. Dhoni led India to the Twenty20 (T20) world title in 2007. Dhoni made his international debut in 2004.
